title: Skydivingclub on ETH
tagline: SkydivingClubEscondido.NFT is a unique NFT that grants you a Skydiving experience in Interlaken, etc
description:
Skydiving Club Escondido NFT on ETH
Inspiration

A few days ago, I had an exhilarating skydiving experience in Interlaken, Switzerland. Meeting my skydiving instructor recently, we brainstormed the idea of an NFT redeemable for a Skydiving experience in Interlaken, Switzerland.

What It Does

This NFT is not just a token, it's a ticket to an unforgettable skydiving experience in Interlaken. What's more, it comes with a 50% discount for a repeat jump within a year if a deposit of 100 CHF is made. To make it truly unique, a personalized skydiving experience video is attached to the NFT.

How We Are Going to Build it

We are planning on leveraging the Typescript/Python SDKs of ETH along with the proposed ETH hooks to build our business logic.

Challenges We Ran Into

Gaining support from the Skydiving Club in Interlaken, a skydiving capital of the world, will be a challenge. However, we are optimistic and plan to expand to Dubai as well.

Accomplishments That We're Proud Of

We are proud to pioneer the first NFT redeemable for a Skydiving experience, to the best of our knowledge.

What We Learned

Starting small and scaling up once proof of concept is established is a practical and efficient approach to project development.

What's Next for Skydiving Club Escondido NFT

We are hopeful that our first holders of our NFTs will redeem them for a Skydiving experience after the hackathon.
how_its_made:
We are planning on leveraging the Typescript/Python SDKs of ETH along with the proposed ETH hooks to build our business logic.

SkydivingClubEscondido.nft was minted on Polygon as a decentralized domain name but we will use IPFS for storage of not only the Skydiving video but also for the ticketing website as well.
